data.name: Latu
data.gender_notes: Latu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Latu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'lat' meaning 'sun' and 'u' meaning 'ray'. In Hindu mythology, Latu is a name for the sun god, Surya, and his rays. It is also a name for the Sun deity's horse, Suryaksha. The name Latu carries the meaning “Sun's Ray” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Latu usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's ray and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the radiant energy of the sun, illuminating the path to knowledge and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Latu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun's Ray.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Latu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu culture, the sun represents life, energy, and vitality. The name Latu, being associated with the sun, carries a strong positive connotation. It is believed that the name bestows upon the bearer the qualities of the sun - radiance, warmth, and strength. Latu is often used as a name for sons in the hope that they will grow up to be strong and vibrant individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the sun is seen as a symbol of the Atman or the inner self. The sun is believed to be the source of all light and consciousness. The name Latu, with its reference to the sun and its rays, thus has a deep spiritual significance. It is believed that the name Latu connects the bearer to the divine light of the sun and helps in the realization of the inner self. It is also believed that the name Latu brings blessings of prosperity, happiness, and good health.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Latu is a Sanskrit name meaning "the one who brings prosperity and good fortune." It is a popular name in Hindu culture, believed to bring blessings of wealth, success, and happiness.
